analyst.summary: Refex Industries has reinvented itself - moving away from the refrigerant-gas business it was originally known for (now being discontinued) into ash-handling logistics for thermal power plants and a fast-growing wind-power project pipeline through its Venwind subsidiary. The most recent quarter shows a sharp revenue acceleration versus a year earlier, well ahead of what the full-year data suggests, driven by these newer businesses scaling up. The important caution: promoters have pledged a large 43.5% of their shareholding, and the company has a history of reporting profit while actually burning operating cash, alongside slower collections from its power-plant clients. We rate this a Hold but flag the pledge and cash-flow-quality issues for direct attention.
